  fun {motive} zero bit n =>
    Nat.strongRec (fun n ih =>
      match n with
      | 0 => zero
      | 1 => bit true 0 zero
      | n + 2 =>
        let b : Bool := (n + 2) % 2 = 1
        let m : ℕ := (n + 2) / 2
        have h : m < n + 2 := by
          have h₁ : m = (n + 2) / 2 := rfl
          have h₂ : (n + 2) / 2 < n + 2 := by
            apply Nat.div_lt_self
            · linarith
            · norm_num
          exact h₂
        bit b m (ih m h)
      ) n
